svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: One tools/call through mcp-toolkit
svg.desc: One tools/call through mcp-toolkit. 10 components in 2 groups. Connections: MCP client to McpServer (tools/call); McpServer to withCors; withCors to withAuth; withAuth to withRateLimit; withRateLimit to withCache; withCache to Your tool handler (miss); Your tool handler to createLogger (logger.info()); withCors to Tool error; withAuth to Tool error; withRateLimit to Tool error; withRateLimit to Redis or Valkey (take a token); withCache to Redis or Valkey (get, set unless isError).

text.tspan: Each withX wraps the tools registered after it, so the last one applied runs innermost: apply cors, auth, rate-limit, cache in that order.
DENIED: THROWN, AND THE SDK RETURNS IT TO
THE CLIENT AS A TOOL ERROR
OPTIONAL STORE; WITHOUT ONE, STATE STAYS IN
